description: This Java source file contains Swagger API documentation schema classes for the Post Dated Checks API in the Fineract project. It defines data transfer objects (DTOs) used for API responses and requests related to post-dated checks, including classes for fetching, updating, deleting, and response details.

classes.name: PostDatedChecksApiResourceSwagger
classes.description: Container class for Swagger API documentation schemas related to post-dated checks, including nested classes for different API request and response models.

classes.name: GetPostDatedChecks
classes.description: Schema class representing the details of a post-dated check for retrieval operations. Contains fields such as id, installmentId, name, accountNo, amount, and date.

classes.name: UpdatePostDatedCheckRequest
classes.description: Schema class representing the request payload for updating a post-dated check. Includes fields like locale, amount, accountNo, repaymentDate, name, dateFormat, and date.

classes.name: UpdatePostDatedCheckResponse
classes.description: Schema class representing the response after updating a post-dated check, including resourceId and change details.

classes.name: UpdateChangesResponse
classes.description: Inner class within UpdatePostDatedCheckResponse that contains the specific change details such as amount, bankName, accountNo, and date.

classes.name: DeletePostDatedCheck
classes.description: Schema class representing the parameters required to delete a post-dated check, specifically loanId and resourceId.

methods.name: <none - schema classes only>
methods.description: The file primarily consists of static nested classes defining schemas; it does not contain typical executable methods.
